main_text.head: DE ORATIONE.
main_text.p: R. Est ardens colloquium fidelis animæ cum Deo, in quo vel precamur, vel deprecamur, vel gratias agimus.

R. Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificetur nomen tuum. Adveniat regnū tuum. Fiat voluntas tua sicut in cœlo & in terra. Panem nostrum quotidianum da nobis hodie. Et remitte nobis debita nostra, sicut & nos remittimus debitoribus nostris. Et ne nos inducas in tentationem, sed libera nos à malo. Amen.
R. Quia me per Christum in filium adoptavit, & hæredem me bonorum omnium constituit. Deinde dedit spiritum filii sui, in quo summa fiducia clamo Pater noster.
R. Admonet hoc nomen fraternæ charitatis.

page.notes: Handwritten mark at the bottom right ("L. Wär" or similar) left out as handwriting. No page number or running head printed. "Fides in Christum." and the question lines are set as printed; the "I." before each question is the printer's Q mark, kept as printed. Initial "E" of "Est" in the answer is a large letter, read as "Est". Printed hyphen "consti-tuit" at a line end kept.
